no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or other external consultants because zanubrutinib is not first-in-class, and the application did not raise new efficacy or safety issues for the recommended indications.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA 213217 (BRUKINSA/zanubrutinib). The Multidiscipline Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee because zanubrutinib is not first-in-class and raised no new efficacy or safety issues for the recommended indication. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
